methods.name: onActivate
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called when the window acquires the keyboard focus.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called when the window is about to be closed.

methods.name: onDeactivate
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called when the window loses the keyboard focus.

methods.name: onMove
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called when the window has been moved

methods.name: onMoving
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called when the window is being moved

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called after the window has been resized

methods.name: onResizing
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called while a window is being resized

methods.name: onShortcutKey
methods.description: In Windows only, an event-handler callback function, called a shortcut-key sequence is typed that matches the shortcutKey value for this window.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: An event-handler callback function, called just before the window is displayed

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog that returns the user’s text input.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The string for the displayed message.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: The initial value to be displayed in the text edit field.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A string to appear as the title of the dialog.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified child control from this window’s children array.

parameters.name: what
parameters.description: The child control to remove, specified by 0-based index, text property value, or as a control object.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Unregisters an event handler for a particular type of event occuring in this window.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The name of the event.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: The function that handles the event.

parameters.name: capturePhase
parameters.description: Whether to call the handler only in the capturing phase of the event propagation.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Makes this window visible.
